name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Content & Marketing Operations Specialist | Website Content, SEO & Digital Asset Management

Runs site-wide SEO and schema audits, builds landing pages and content libraries, and coordinates with sales, product, and outside partners to keep web presence accurate and performing.
